name: ciallang-language
description: Ciallang / TJS2 syntax highlighting and language tools

ciallang.declarationFiles.description: Additional .d.tjs files, absolute or relative to the active workspace; workspace declarations are discovered automatically

scripts.check: node --check extension.js && node --check launch-options.js && node --check prepare.js && node --check test/smoke.js
